tools.name: status
tools.why: Cached inference-pool capacity summary. Reads no host file, process, window or secret and probes nothing.

tools.name: admin_whoami
tools.why: Reports the account attached to the caller's own session token. Acts on nothing.

tools.name: tool_help
tools.why: Static argument help for advertised tools. Read-only.

tools.name: command_registry_list
tools.why: Static listing of slash commands by name, category and risk. Read-only.

tools.name: tool_manifest
tools.why: Tool name list. On the served path it is replaced by the role-filtered manifest, so a user sees only what the role may run.

tools.name: tool_capability_manifest
tools.why: Tool schemas and fingerprint. On the served path it is replaced by the role-filtered manifest. Visibility only.
